rationale: P identifies the vehicle behavior that must be characterised to evaluate 'Prevent unintended braking': whether braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended. H-3 and SG-3 establish braking itself as the subject of evaluation, not merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon. The declared scope matches H-3's operational situation. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism-specific timing requirements.
determining_elements: 'Braking behavior of the ego vehicle' directly addresses the behavior targeted by H-3 and SG-3.
'Whether braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended' captures the occurrence and character needed to evaluate the target.
The scope preserves the supplied straight-ahead urban driving situation at 50 km/h, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead and good weather.
No supporting mechanisms or their timing constraints are included as part of P.
